svg.title: Boubou: from a terminal command to a local voice conversation
svg.desc: An illustrative, thirty-second loop of the current macOS source build. Run boubou, choose Liquid Audio, download and verify the model, speak, hear a reply, then interrupt by speaking again. Setup time is condensed. No real audio or personal transcript is used.
